name: Narrative Form Triage Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for a form-triage run and the spine contract it produces. Scores the gate, not the eventual prose. Minimum standard: average >= 3.5.

criteria.name: Gate Ran Before Structure
criteria.description: Whether the six-question triage and the ABT diagnostic were completed on the assembled evidence before any structure, theme or outline was proposed

scores.1: No gate; a structure was chosen or an arc was described from the outset
scores.2: Gate mentioned but run after a structure was already assumed, as justification
scores.3: Gate run before structure selection, but the chronology table was thin or partly assembled afterward
scores.4: Chronology table complete first, then ABT, then the six questions, in order
scores.5: Full order held, source-type flags recorded per row, and no theme or thesis proposed before the table was complete

criteria.name: Citation Discipline on Every Slot
criteria.description: Whether each triage answer and each ABT slot carries a specific corpus reference, with uncited answers treated as NO

scores.1: No citations; answers are assertions and the ABT reads well while citing nothing
scores.2: Some slots cited, others asserted, with no distinction drawn between them
scores.3: Most slots cited; a few uncited YES answers survived into the form declaration
scores.4: Every YES carries a reference; uncited answers were converted to NO
scores.5: Every slot cited, sources tagged primary-contemporaneous or secondary-retrospective, and no mechanism claim rests on a secondary retrospective alone

criteria.name: Refusal Capability
criteria.description: Whether DO NOT NARRATE, NO BUT IN MATERIAL and NO POINT OF INSIGHT are available and used when the evidence warrants, without being softened into a weaker arc

scores.1: An arc was produced regardless of evidence; empty slots were filled by inference or invention
scores.2: Weaknesses noted in passing, then a story form adopted anyway
scores.3: Form correctly downgraded, but the refusal is buried or apologetic rather than delivered as a finding
scores.4: Refusal delivered as a first-class output with reasons and failing question numbers, and empty slots logged with a chosen move
scores.5: As 4, plus the counter-check: the strongest agency-based reading is named and its rejection reasoned, so the refusal is not anti-narrative reflex

criteria.name: Structure Fit and Runner-Up
criteria.description: Whether the selected spine is keyed on contradiction count, subject type, audience obligation, outcome knowledge and audience stance, with a named runner-up and a stated reason it lost

scores.1: Structure named with no rationale, or a default arc applied to system material
scores.2: Rationale given for one or two keys only; no runner-up recorded
scores.3: Most keys applied; runner-up named but with no reason it lost
scores.4: All five keys applied explicitly; runner-up named with a reason
scores.5: As 4, plus the system remap applied where the subject is not a person, and any agentic template either remapped slot by slot or abandoned

criteria.name: Boredom Budget and Nesting Declared
criteria.description: Whether the contract states in one sentence where the chosen structure permits low-engagement prose, and declares nesting depth within the one-level limit for explanation inside story

scores.1: Neither stated; the structure is a label with no operating rules
scores.2: Boredom zone gestured at vaguely ('keep it engaging'); nesting unaddressed
scores.3: Boredom sentence present and correct for the structure; nesting mentioned without depth
scores.4: Both stated precisely, and the one-nut-graf limit on explanation inside story is respected
scores.5: As 4, plus dense evidence runs marked and each placed in a permitted zone, appendixed, compressed, or paid for with a scene

criteria.name: Warranted Antagonists and Non-Agentic Language
criteria.description: Whether any opponent meets the competition, awareness and directed-action tests, with verbs matching the tier, and whether systems are kept free of wants and intent

scores.1: A named party is assigned intent with no documentary support, or the subject system decides, wants or believes
scores.2: An opponent is asserted with one evidence type; agency language appears unremarked
scores.3: Opponent tier assessed but verbs not constrained to the tier
scores.4: Tier assigned from the three tests, verbs constrained accordingly, and the empty case declared where nothing reaches two of three
scores.5: As 4, plus every system-level force cashed out into its mechanism in the same sentence, with no anthropomorphism anywhere in the contract

criteria.name: Set-Aside and Contradiction Handling
criteria.description: Whether DHY material was split or explicitly demoted with disclosure, and whether evidence that contradicts is distinguished from evidence that merely fails to support

scores.1: Multi-causal material silently flattened to one elegant mechanism; nothing logged
scores.2: A single spine chosen with a passing acknowledgment that other factors exist
scores.3: Set-aside log present but does not separate contradicting from not-supporting evidence
scores.4: Contradictions named, the reduction reasoned, and the two evidence categories separated
scores.5: As 4, plus contradicting evidence routed into the body of the plan rather than an appendix, and one thing the chosen lens does not explain stated outright

criteria.name: Contract Completeness and Immutability
criteria.description: Whether all eleven contract fields are present, attribution caveats carried, and the spine frozen against mid-draft substitution

scores.1: No contract; the output is prose or an outline
scores.2: Partial contract; several required fields absent
scores.3: Most fields present; attribution caveats missing or sources misattributed
scores.4: All eleven fields present, attributions correct, and the freeze stated
scores.5: As 4, plus derived defaults and the Hart, Oregon Method and SCAM caveats carried verbatim, and a logged restart path defined for structural change
